title: Repair cases
subject: Islamic Studies
source: Written for islamic-studies/y7 lesson 26 (Pupil PDF worksheet: repair cases)
intro: Lesson 26: Common mistakes in salah and sujud as-sahw. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

head: Mistake
Fix
rows: Forehead or nose not touching the floor
Look to the place of sujud

panels.title: When the Prophet ﷺ forgot
points: He prayed five rak'ahs of Dhuhr

panels.title: When to do sujud as-sahw
points: Adding a rak'ah, ruku' or sujud by mistake
Doubt: build on what you are sure of

parts.text: Then the taslim (or before it, as some reports show)

questions.q: Forgot to say the tasbih in ruku'.
questions.a: Obligatory act: sujud as-sahw at the end.

questions.q: Forgot the first tashahhud and stood up.
Unsure whether two or three rak'ahs.
questions.a: Build on certainty: take two, continue, then sujud as-sahw.

questions.q: Unsure whether three or four rak'ahs of 'Asr.
questions.a: Take three, pray one more, then sujud as-sahw.

questions.q: Prayed five rak'ahs of Dhuhr by mistake.
questions.a: Sujud as-sahw: the Prophet ﷺ did two sujud as-sahw when this happened.

questions.q: Forgot ruku' and remembered in sujud.
questions.a: A pillar: go back and do it, then sujud as-sahw.

questions.q: Explain what to do if you add a fifth rak'ah by mistake.
questions.a: Finish the prayer and do sujud as-sahw, as the Prophet ﷺ did (Bukhari and Muslim).
What we are sure of (the lower number)
options: What we are sure of (the lower number)

questions.q: Six repair cases on the pupil PDF: write the right repair and the evidence (e.g. forgot to say the tasbih in ruku'; forgot the first tashahhud and stood up; unsure whether two or three rak'ahs).
questions.a: Repairs: tasbih forgotten: sahw; first tashahhud: continue and sahw; unsure 2 or 3: take 2, continue, sahw

questions.q: Extend: why should we not race ahead of the imam?
questions.a: The imam is to be followed; racing ahead is a serious mistake.

questions.q: Stretch: how does sujud as-sahw show the mercy of Islam?
questions.a: We are human and forget; Allah gave an easy repair.

questions.q: You are not sure if you prayed three or four rak'ahs of Asr. What do you do?
options: Take three, pray one more, then sujud as-sahw
questions.a: A) Take three, pray one more, then sujud as-sahw. Build on certainty (the lower number) and do sujud as-sahw (Muslim).

questions.q: Sujud as-sahw is how many prostrations?
Think again: why might the Prophet ﷺ have forgotten?
questions.a: To teach us how to repair forgetfulness in prayer.
